<thought>Based on the six pairwise resistance measurements, the only tree (three‑resistor) network that satisfies all values is a linear chain: B – N_d2 – N_d1 – X3.  
The resistor values are:  

- B ↔ N_d2 : 20 Ω  
- N_d2 ↔ N_d1 : 15 Ω  
- N_d1 ↔ X3 : 10 Ω  

Following the note that resistors are labeled from left to right (X3 → B), we assign:  

- R1 = 10 Ω (X3‑N_d1)  
- R2 = 15 Ω (N_d1‑N_d2)  
- R3 = 20 Ω (N_d2‑B)  

The JSON representation of the topology is therefore:</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 10, "R2": 15, "R3": 20}, "connections": [["X3","N_d1","R1"], ["N_d1","N_d2","R2"], ["N_d2","B","R3"]]}</final_answer>
